package intervention

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type TeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type IDGenerator interface{ NewID() string }
type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type DialogGateway interface {
	repository.TeacherDialogProvisioner
	repository.DialogTeacherProactiveAppender
}

type Result struct {
	Decision  domain.TeacherDecision
	Delivered bool
}

type Engine struct {
	Teachers TeacherEnsurer
	Policies *Registry
	Store    repository.InterventionStore
	Dialogs  DialogGateway
	IDs      IDGenerator
	Clock    Clock
}

func (engine Engine) Handle(ctx context.Context, raw domain.LearningActivitySignal) (bool, error) {
	signal, err := domain.NewLearningActivitySignal(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if engine.Teachers == nil || engine.Policies == nil || engine.Store == nil || engine.Dialogs == nil || engine.IDs == nil || engine.Clock == nil {
		return false, errors.New("intervention engine dependencies are required")
	}
	teacher, err := engine.Teachers.Execute(ctx, signal.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	policy := engine.Policies.Resolve(teacher.InterventionMode)
	if policy == nil {
		return false, errors.New("intervention policy is unavailable")
	}
	plan := policy.Evaluate(teacher, signal)
	if plan.Action == domain.TeacherActionIntervene {
		alreadyDelivered, checkErr := engine.Store.HasDeliveredInSession(ctx, signal.StudentID, signal.AnalyticsSessionID)
		if checkErr != nil {
			return false, checkErr
		}
		if alreadyDelivered {
			plan = silent("session_intervention_cooldown", "A proactive offer was already delivered in this analytics session.")
		}
	}
	now := engine.Clock.Now().UTC()
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(domain.TeacherDecision{
		ID: engine.IDs.NewID(), PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, StudentID: signal.StudentID,
		CorrelationID: signal.AnalyticsSessionID, CausationID: signal.EventID,
		TeachingMode: domain.TeachingModePractice, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
		PedagogyMethod: "intervention-" + policy.Code(), PedagogyVersion: policy.Version(), PedagogyStage: "monitor",
		Strategy: "timely_support", Action: plan.Action, ReasonCode: plan.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: plan.ReasonSummary, PolicyVersion: policy.Version(), CreatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(
		engine.IDs.NewID(), domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded, decision.CorrelationID,
		decision.CausationID, decision.StudentID, decision.CreatedAt,
		domain.TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion, decision,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	record, created, err := engine.Store.Commit(ctx, signal, domain.InterventionRecord{
		EventID: signal.EventID, StudentID: signal.StudentID, AnalyticsSessionID: signal.AnalyticsSessionID,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, DecisionID: decision.ID, SignalType: signal.SignalType, Action: decision.Action,
		OfferBody: plan.OfferBody, CreatedAt: now,
	}, decision, event)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if record.Action == domain.TeacherActionStaySilent || record.DeliveredAt != nil {
		return created, nil
	}
	binding, err := engine.Dialogs.EnsureTeacherDialog(ctx, record.StudentID, record.PersonalTeacherID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "")
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	message, err := engine.Dialogs.AppendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, record.EventID, record.OfferBody)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if err := engine.Store.MarkDelivered(ctx, record.EventID, binding.ID, message.ID, engine.Clock.Now()); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return created, nil
}
